items.title: Tanking gas prices could be the setup needed for strong holiday season
items.summary: US gas prices (RB=F) have slipped lower for 31 straight days, setting retailers up for what could be a hotter-than-expected holiday shopping season. Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi dives into the factors loosening up spending money for US consumers ahead of the Black Friday holiday.
